summary: FIRST_VALUE returns the expression from the first row in the current window frame.
syntax: FIRST_VALUE(value) OVER (PARTITION BY group_key ORDER BY sequence ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)
documentation: FIRST_VALUE returns the expression from the first row in the current window frame. A full-partition frame repeats the earliest ordered value for every row in that partition. Unlike MIN, it selects by row order rather than by the smallest measured value.
inputs: readings(id INTEGER, device TEXT, value INTEGER).
returns: id, device and baseline, ordered by device then id.
caution: FIRST_VALUE respects NULL: a NULL earliest reading remains the baseline. Choose a deterministic ordering and an explicit frame.
scenarios: Repeat an opening balance beside each later record.
Compare sensor readings with their first recorded baseline.
Attach the initial estimate to each ordered project revision.
title: Carry the first device reading
problem: Return id, device and the earliest value by id within each device AS baseline. Repeat it on every row. Include an explicit full-partition ROWS frame and order output by device, id.
goal: Use FIRST_VALUE() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
